intro: Andi Lynn in Gadgetzan warns of a large band of nomadic ogres that has lately arrived in Tanaris. South of town they have formed a compound, and Andi Lynn wants it destroyed before they can build up a force.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Just recently, a large bank of nomadic ogres arrived in Tanaris. South of here, they have taken over a large area of the desert and formed a compound. Several smaller bands are currently wandering the desert, some of which have invaded the old troll ruins.
The Dunemaul Compound must be destroyed! We cannot allow these ogres to build up a force.
The leader of this band is named Gor'marok the Ravager; I believe that putting an end to his leadership will be the beginning of the end for the ogres.

clips.title: Progress
paras: I'm so worried! Please be careful!

clips.title: Completion
paras: I'm so glad you were able to do this for me, friend! Thanks for your help!
